biography: Max Wilson, born in the vibrant heart of São Paulo, Brazil, was practically raised on the roar of engines. His father, a mechanic for a local karting team, instilled a love for speed and competition from a young age. Max's early karting career was a whirlwind of raw talent and aggressive overtakes, earning him the nickname 'The Samba Storm'. He transitioned to single-seaters, quickly climbing the ranks with a series of dominant performances in Formula Three Sudamericana. A defining moment came at Interlagos in 2008 when, against all odds, he wrestled his underpowered car to a podium finish in front of a roaring home crowd. This performance caught the eye of Mercedes-AMG, who signed him to their junior program. While he showed flashes of brilliance in GT racing with RCM, consistency eluded him, and now, at 36, Wilson finds himself battling to stay relevant as younger talent emerges.
drivingStyle: Wilson is known for his flamboyant and aggressive driving style. He's a late-braking specialist, often throwing his car into corners with a daring disregard for the limits of grip. This approach can lead to spectacular overtakes and impressive lap times, but it also results in costly mistakes and tire degradation. While undeniably exciting to watch, his lack of finesse has often been criticized, with some claiming he prioritizes showmanship over strategic race management. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days. Bellini always accused Wilson of unfair tactics and aggressive driving.
A clash of personalities and driving styles. Dubois, known for her calculated and precise approach, often criticized Wilson's recklessness, leading to on-track incidents and heated exchanges.
Internal team rivalry during their time at RCM. Both drivers constantly battled for the number one spot, creating tension within the team and often leading to strategic compromises.

quirks: Always wears the same faded lucky racing gloves, despite their obvious wear and tear.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba track before every race to calm his nerves.
Refuses to start a race without first polishing his helmet visor to a mirror shine.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about precision; it's about passion. If you're not willing to risk it all, you're not really racing."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2012 Spa 24 Hours with Mercedes-AMG, showcasing his ability to perform under pressure in a demanding endurance race.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2015 Bathurst 1000, costing RCM a guaranteed victory and severely damaging his reputation within the team.
